claim: On every Nightmare level pests and bosses start at 40% health and reach full health by 8:00, so the first minutes are the cheapest time to get stronger.
evidence: Stated in the game facts given at loop start; no game played yet.

claim: Steam-vent survived seed 202 NM1 under lockstep, so the earlier seed dependence was reaction lag.
evidence: L1.I1.G3 steam-vent alive at 300s on NM1 seed 101, but L1.I2.G4 steam-vent died at 166s on NM1 seed 202 to boss amusing (96.5 damage); the lead is seed-dependent.

claim: Raising extraDamage from 0.02 to 0.06 does not help; fry-knives died sooner.
evidence: L1.I1.G5 died 130s at level 4 versus G1 baseline died 154s at level 8; one game each.

claim: The Festival Mascot boss (amusing) arrives around 2:00 on Nightmare 1 and deals a large share of early damage (37-47 in a 300s game).
evidence: L1.I1.G3 steam-vent boss:amusing 36.6 damage; L1.I1.G5 fry-knives boss:amusing 46.6 damage, died at 130s. Seed 101 only.

claim: extraDamage 0.06 did not help; both fry-knives games died early, but weapon choice dominated.
evidence: L1.I1.G5 died 130s vs G1 154s; one game each, both fry-knives, so weapon is the confound.

claim: On Nightmare 10 every tested start (steam-vent, sprout-satellites, rosti-disc, steam-vent 8 with root-network) died within 127s at level 8 or lower; pests such as bowling-ball, sand-crab and aphid do most of the damage.
evidence: L1.I2.G1 died 86s, G2 127s, G3 118s, G5 92s, all seed 303; one game each.

claim: Lockstep 1 (no reaction lag while models decide) improves early survival on Nightmare 10 with steam-vent.
evidence: Lockstep is now banned; every game plays live. All earlier lockstep results (including the picks-only 8 of 8 in L5.I1-I2) must be rechecked live. L5.I3 plays the shipped playbook live on 5 fresh seeds.

claim: On Nightmare 10 the Festival Mascot (amusing) at 2:00 is the main killer of early live (lockstep 0) runs: it dealt 74 to 99 damage and landed the killing blow in the three seed-101 steam-vent games that reached it. Under lockstep 1 it still dealt 123.5 damage in one game but Tibo survived.
evidence: L1.I2.G2 boss:amusing 99.5 damage, died 142s; L1.I2.G4 79, died 132s; L1.I2.G5 74.1, died 132s (all live). L1.I3.G4 lockstep: amusing 123.5 damage, health 43/149 at 2:00, alive and 163/163 at 3:00.

claim: Opening chests and evolving early (first chest by about 1:35) separates 300s survivors from deaths on NM10; the three bosses at 2:00, 3:00 and 4:00 kill weak builds.
evidence: L1.I4.G3 and G5 had 7 to 9 boss chests and 9 bosses killed, alive at 300s; G1 had 0 boss chests and died at 244s to The Masher; G4 had 1 and died at 213s.

claim: distrustBossRange and bossOfferRange (250 to 300) do not reliably lower total damage and can raise it, so the full run leaves them at 0.
evidence: Earlier pairs show no consistent direction in 8 pairs (seed 505 NM10 67 vs 30; fresh NM1 seed 606 185 vs 36; 10:00 gyms lower with ranges, 45 vs 98 and 58 vs 79). L1.I9.G5, nm1-min5-fresh with chest-first plus ranges 250, died at 74s (Late Blight 103 damage, 6 dashes, 2 picks), while chest-first without ranges survived 3 of 3 on the same gym.

claim: A mid-strength build (about level 10 with steam-vent evolving to pressure-cooker) clears the 2:00 and 3:00 bosses on Nightmare 10 under any movement setting, so build strength matters more than movement settings for boss survival.
evidence: L1.I3.G1/G2/G3 from gym boss-nm10-strong: all alive after 90s with 16, 8 and 36 damage taken (lockstep, lockstep plus ranges, live).

claim: The next full run is Nightmare 1 and has to survive 20:00, but training games cap at 300s, so minutes 5-20 can only be tested from gyms saved at later times.
evidence: Ladder state: no level won yet, so the next full run is Nightmare 1. Game length cap is 300s per training game.

claim: A longer planEvery (10 instead of 5) hurts survival under lockstep: it died on NM10 seed 505 and on NM1 good seeds 1313 and 1818.
evidence: L1.I5.G5 died 188.7s; L3.I7.G1 died 4:59 and G2 died 4:01, both with 0 chests, against plain survivors on the same seeds.

claim: On Nightmare 1, builds saved at 6:00 and 10:00 (level 20 to 38, evolved) survive 300s more at near-full health, so the early minutes are where runs are lost.
evidence: L1.I6.G1/G2/G3 and L1.I4.G2/G4/G5: all alive at full health, 11 to 98 damage taken.

claim: A strong steam-vent build (level 20+ with hot-streak or pressure-cooker and HP passives) survives 5 minutes from 6:00 or 10:00 on Nightmare 1 with at most 100 damage under the default playbook, so those gyms cannot separate knobs or prompts.
evidence: L1.I4.G2 12, G3 14, G4 98, G5 45 damage; L1.I6.G1 79, G2 58, G3 11 damage; all seven alive at 300s with 192+ max HP.

claim: Lockstep 1 steam-vent survives the seed 202 NM1 opening that killed it under live play; planEvery 3 and a peeler start also survive.
evidence: L1.I7.G1 alive 300s 56 damage, G2 planEvery 3 69 damage, G3 peeler 93 damage, all seed 202; live L1.I2.G4 died 166s.

claim: A natural Nightmare 1 build at 5:00 (level 17, no evolution) is at risk from the 6:00 to 8:00 bosses (Late Blight, Sir Strawman, Fryer King) under the default playbook, unlike the strong swapped-in gyms.
evidence: L1.I5.G1 baseline died at 198s (Fryer King 77.5, Late Blight 68.9; 2 boss chests, no evolution). L1.I6.G1 baseline died at 147s (Late Blight 67.9, Sir Strawman 58.1; 1 boss chest, no evolution). L1.I7.G4 sonnet-medium baseline from the 5:00 state survived with 55 damage. Two deaths in three default games on nm1-min5-fresh.

claim: A goal prompt that puts chests and elites first while health is above half gives many more boss chests and evolutions than the default prompt, and it carried the full run through the first 16 minutes of Nightmare 1.
evidence: Chest-first survived 12 of 12 natural builds in training. L1.I10 full run: lived 18:36 with 32 boss chests and 5 evolutions, hp 192/192 until 17:00. The default prompt died 3 of 4 on nm1-min5-fresh.

claim: An evolve-focused planner.pick prompt does not help on Nightmare 1 and may hurt.
evidence: L1.I8.G2 died at 88s from nm1-min5-fresh with no evolution. L1.I8.G4 seed 707: 333 kills and 0 chests against baseline G3 1575 kills. L1.I5.G2 survived at 50/120 and L1.I5.G5 survived with 981 kills against 1097.

claim: Steam-vent, lockstep 1 and the chest-first goal prompt lived 17:20 on Nightmare 1 in the full run, the best result so far.
evidence: L1.I10 sonnet-medium full run seed SEOJT4: 17:20, level 62, 25 boss chests, 4 evolutions. sonnet-high full run seed 1HY6I94 later lived 18:36 with the same base.

claim: Raising eliteSeconds from 20 to 35 does not give more boss chests or less damage on a natural Nightmare 1 build.
evidence: L1.I8.G5 from nm1-min5-fresh: 12 boss chests and 266 damage, dropped 7 elite goals and spent 7 on evade (health 43/120 at 6:00, 8 dashes at 6:30-7:30). Earlier chest-first games on that gym with eliteSeconds 20 had 12 to 26 chests and 29 to 374 damage. One game.

claim: A steam-vent start beats a peeler start on a fresh Nightmare 1 map under the chest-first playbook.
evidence: Seed 909: steam-vent 60 damage, 19 boss chests, 3 evolutions (fry-fortress 1:51, pressure-cooker 2:11, golden-harvest 4:04); peeler 218 damage, 14 boss chests, 2 evolutions (factory-reset 3:07, mandoline-fury 4:00). Seed 202 peeler also survived with 93 damage. One game each on seed 909.

claim: A gym saved on an older game build cannot be loaded after the page build changes, so gyms should be used soon after they are saved.
evidence: L1.I8.G4: checkpoint gym-nm1-min5-s808-chest was saved on build sim-wTU8O3Z8.js and the page runs sim-DA4RGMxM.js, so the game did not play.

claim: The chest-first goal text does not need a boss-adjacent evade exception: the package (boss-within-120 evade plus boss-only dash) lived 2 of 4 live, the same as the unchanged control on the same seeds.
evidence: L4.I1/L4.I2 paired live: 1919 package died 2:35 vs control 2:30; 2020 both alive (301 vs 140 damage); 4242 both alive (198 vs 126); 4141 package died 1:50 vs control 3:06. Package 2 of 4, control 2 of 4, and more damage on the survivor seeds.

claim: An HP/dash pick prompt did not help on the full-build gym either: it died at 18:09, earlier than the baseline at 18:32.
evidence: L2.I4.G3 died 18:09 (Titan 208, ice-imp 181, Kraken 169) vs G1 baseline 18:32; one game each.

claim: Gyms built by playing a natural build to 15:00 or 16:40 usually fail because the build dies on the way; late gyms need a swapped-in loadout, and even swapped loadouts with evolved late weapons crashed the bot twice (exit code 1), so copy a loadout shape that has saved before.
evidence: L2.I1: nm1-min15-late died at 8:32 and nm1-min16-titan at 6:37; L2.I2: -b gyms with the full run's evolved loadout exited with code 1; earlier loadout gyms (nm1-min10-mine, nm1-min6-mine) saved. L2.I3 retries with the nm1-min10-mine loadout shape.

claim: Leaving gold, shrines, skips and rerolls unused wastes power: the full run earned 7946 gold and spent 838, used 0 shrines, and bought 0 items.
evidence: L1.I10 full run: gold earned 7946, spent 838, shrines 0. L2.I10 full run with the gold rule: earned 17767, spent 14338, shrines 3, hp 150/150 from 15:00 to 20:00.

claim: On Nightmare 1 the pest count doubles from about 400 to about 790 at 16:00, and ice-imp, grease-fiend and the 17:00 and 18:00 bosses (Compost Titan, Ketchup Kraken) deal most late damage, in bursts of 70-100 hp.
evidence: L1.I10 stats: enemies 403 at 15:00, 788 at 16:00, 800 at 17:00; damage by source ice-imp 334, kraken 321, titan 243, grease-fiend 139; bursts 79 hp at 14:00, 252 at 17:00, 551 at 18:00.

claim: Steam-vent with lockstep 1 and the chest-first goal prompt is a reliable base: two full runs lived 17:20 and 18:36 on Nightmare 1. The unsolved part is minutes 16-20.
evidence: sonnet-medium L1.I10 17:20; sonnet-high L1.I10 18:36; sonnet-high L2.I10 24:47 with the gold rule added, a win on Nightmare 1.

claim: The swapped grease-fire loadout gyms (nm1-min15-c, nm1-min16-titan-c) are too strong to test late fixes: they pass 20:00 with little damage, so the Titan and Kraken barely hurt them.
evidence: L2.I3: G5 from 15:00 reached 20:00 with 11 damage; four games from 16:40 all passed 20:00 (deaths at 20:17 to 21:10 came from Harvester and Fryer King); Titan and Kraken dealt 0 to 70.

claim: On the full-build gym the boss-aware goal passes 20:00 in 4 of 5 games where the baseline and pick variants die at 18:07-18:32; on lo-full and lo-surv the evidence is mixed, so it is not yet proven across builds.
evidence: L2.I4/L2.I5 full gym: boss-aware text passed 20:00 in 4 of 5 (died 21:06, 21:03, 20:33, 20:16; planEvery 3 variant 18:52). L2.I6 lo-full boss-aware passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 (died 21:02, 20:11), against an earlier single lo-full game at 18:29. A rewritten text with a 350-unit rule died 18:37 on the full gym, so the exact wording matters. Baselines on the full gym died 18:07-18:32.

claim: From the lo-full gym at 16:40, the chest-first baseline gets past 20:00 (both games), so a damage-passive build with pressure-cooker, gratin-arc, mash-avalanche, tater-minigun and mandoline-fury can survive the Titan, Kraken and Harvester; lo-surv is the failing gym.
evidence: L2.I1.G1 died 20:45 (Harvester 332, Kraken 305, Titan 296 damage taken, healed back); L2.I1.G5 died 21:11 (Fryer King 312); both passed 20:00 at 211 max hp. lo-surv: L2.I1.G3 died 18:07.

claim: A permissive late-game dash prompt makes things worse: it spends many charges and dies sooner than the default prompt.
evidence: L2.I2 lo-surv: permissive dash A died 17:55 (30 dashes, 1215 damage), B died 17:20 (18 dashes, 950 damage); default baselines died 18:07 and 19:13 with 4 dashes at most. distrustSeconds 10 with 0 dashes died 18:21. More dashing did not lower damage.

claim: distrustSeconds 10 does not help at 16:40-20:00 on Nightmare 1.
evidence: L2.I2.G4 lo-surv died 18:21 (852 damage: ice-imp 338, Kraken 214, Titan 208), inside the baseline range of 18:07 to 19:13. One game.

claim: A gold/shop sentence in the chest-first goal prompt is unresolved: it died at 17:26 on lo-surv, but survived to 20:40 on the full gym with items A and 8000 gold. Late in the run it rarely produces purchases.
evidence: L2.I2.G5 lo-surv died 17:26 with 688 gold earned, 0 spent. L2.I4.G5 full gym, 8000 gold, items A, gold sentence: alive 20:40, 616 damage, 1 crate bought. L2.I5.G3 and G4 (boss-aware plus gold rule, 8000 gold, only Potato Knish) died 18:47 and 18:19 with 0 bought and spot goals 0 done, so spending is not working in the crowd, and no spend has lowered damage yet.

claim: The lo-surv gym kills the hp/dash build (Butter Socks, Stuffed Skin) between 17:53 and 19:13, but the same map with damage passives (Butter Pat, Aged Russet) passed 20:00 twice, so the cause is the build and not the map.
evidence: L2.I3.G3 and G4 (damage passives, lo-surv map): both died 20:07 to the Harvester after passing 20:00 (741 and 817 damage). Hp/dash baselines died 18:07, 19:13 and 17:53 (1114, 1609, 1069 damage). Lo-full (damage passives, other seed) passed 20:00 twice.

claim: Damage passives (Butter Pat 5, Aged Russet 5) beat hp/dash passives (Butter Socks 5, Stuffed Skin 5) for the 16:40-20:00 stretch on Nightmare 1, so late picks should not trade a damage passive for hp or dash.
evidence: Damage build 4 of 4 past 20:00 (lo-full 20:45 and 21:11; lo-surv swap 20:07 and 20:07). Hp/dash build 0 of 3 (18:07, 19:13, 17:53). The full gym hp/dash pick prompt died 18:09 (L2.I4.G3). One caveat: the full gym with damage passives and few items died at 18:32.

claim: Starch Plating 5 in place of Stuffed Skin is not a fix: it lasted about as long as the hp/dash baselines' upper range and shorter than damage passives.
evidence: L2.I3.G1 died 19:40 (1383 damage, grease-fiend 528); G2 died 20:18 (1802 damage, ice-imp 403, Titan 383, mud-golem 329). Damage-passive swaps died 20:07 twice with 741 and 817 damage. Two games.

claim: Items decide the full gym (seed 1JV4MGC, damage build, 16:40): with nine defensive items (2 Baked Buckler, 2 Ghost Skin, Thorny Jacket, 2 Spud Muffin, 2 Vampire Tot) it passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 games at 259 max hp, while the same build with the damage items A or the Potato Knish alone died at 18:06-18:32. Which items matter (armor, dodge, max hp, thorns, kill-heal) is untested.
evidence: L2.I4 items B: G3 alive 20:40 (288 damage), G4 alive 20:40 (569 damage, 259 hp). Items A: G1 died 18:14 (Kraken 321), G2 died 18:06 (Titan 347). Knish-only baselines died 18:32 and 18:07. One caveat: items A plus 8000 gold and the gold sentence (G5) survived to 20:40 with 616 damage and 221 hp.

claim: planEvery 3 on top of the boss-aware goal does not help late: it died at 18:52 on the full gym, earlier than the other boss-aware games.
evidence: L2.I5.G4 died 18:52 (Kraken 641, ice-imp 124) vs 20:16-21:06 for the other boss-aware games; one game.

claim: Late in the run spot goals (crates, Fry Cart, shrines) mostly fail or get dropped in the 800-pest crowd, so unspent gold stays unspent unless the goal rule fires while no boss is near.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: with the gold rule from 10:00 and no boss within 300, spot goals finished 28, gave up 1, dropped 3, with 17 crates bought. The earlier failures (L2.I4/L2.I5) were from an 800-pest crowd and a boss near, without the 10:00 gating.

claim: evadeSeconds 15 does not reliably beat 8 on the full gym; the single 20:40 survivor was not repeated.
evidence: L2.I7: full gym evade 15 died 19:34 and 18:16, lo-full evade 15 died 20:07; playbook repeats died 18:04 and 18:41. L2.I6 (my boss-aware text): evade 15 on the full gym died 18:07, alive 20:40 (G2, health 42/221 at 19:00, Kraken 1392 damage, 10 dashes), died 18:15; evade 25 died 18:16; lo-full evade 15 alive 20:40. Evade 15 passes 20:00 in 2 of 6 on the full gym, so it is not reliable.

claim: The current playbook goal text (boss rule at 300 units) does not carry the full gym past 18:41; the boss-aware text that passed 20:00 4 of 5 earlier is not the one in the playbook, so wording matters a lot.
evidence: L2.I7.G1 died 18:04 (Kraken 151, ice-imp 125), G2 died 18:41 (Kraken 428, ice-imp 162); baselines before died 18:07-18:32.

claim: No goal-text, boss-range, evade-length or hurt-prompt variant tried in L2.I8 beats the playbook baseline on the full gym; the 18:00 Kraken, Titan and ice-imp window is not fixed by prompts or knobs.
evidence: L2.I8 on nm1-min16-full: strict evade text died 18:15, plus ranges 300 18:42, plus evade 15 19:59, plus boss-aware hurt prompt 18:23, playbook text plus ranges 300 18:31. Baselines died 18:04-18:41 (L2.I5, L2.I7).

claim: On the full gym every prompt and knob variant tried so far (boss-aware text, evade 8/15/25, boss ranges, planEvery 3, hp/dash picks, gold sentence) dies at 18:04-18:52 in most games. The only variant that passed 20:00 in 2 of 2 was holding nine defensive items, so the next test is which items carry it.
evidence: L2.I4 items B: G3 and G4 alive 20:40. Items A and prompt/knob variants in L2.I4-L2.I8: 18:04-18:52 in most games, with 20:00 passes in only 3 of 15 or so (L2.I5.G5, L2.I6.G2, medium's boss-aware runs). L2.I7 of this iteration splits set B into armor/dodge and max hp/sustain halves.

claim: Armor and dodge items were the only late lever that held in gyms, but the last full run died at 6:42 before items mattered; early survival still needs work.
evidence: L2.I9 gyms alive 20:40; L2.I10 full run died 6:42 with no items.

claim: A chest-first goal prompt with a 'many enemies close' evade exception makes the bot evade almost all game, starving chests and evolutions, and died at 6:42.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: evade goal 43 done, 1 chest, no evolution, died 6:42. L3.I1.G5 control with the same playbook text on seed 1313 died 4:28 (3 chests/1 chest-ish, no evolution, 9 dashes).

claim: Scattering level-ups across Steam Vent, Hash Hawk and Locked Gatling with no catalyst plus rerolls leaves no evolution by 6:00; the build must commit to one weapon plus catalyst.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: Steam Vent 3/8, Hash Hawk 1/8, Locked Gatling 7/8, Masher Grip 4/5, no Root Network, two Reroll picks, no evolution at 6:42.

claim: Armor (Baked Buckler) and dodge (Ghost Skin) items are the late-game levers; max hp alone and thorns/kill-heal are weaker, but the repeat of armor plus dodge on the full gym was mixed (1 of 2 alive at 20:40).
evidence: L2.I9: armor alive 20:40 with 222 damage, dodge alive 20:40 with 82 damage. L2.I7: armor plus dodge together alive at 20:40 (555 damage) and died 18:13; max hp plus sustain alive (1230 damage) and died 20:38.

claim: A gold rule that rates crates, Fry Cart, Whetstone and shrines like chests while no boss is near converts gold into items before the crowd arrives; from a natural 10:00 build it spent 5189 gold with little damage.
evidence: L2.I7.G5 56 damage, 8 crates, 5189 gold spent. L2.I8 gold rule alone 22 damage and with armor picks 77, against baselines 231 and 308. L2.I9 map-c: new text 87 and 0 damage with 10 and 6 crates, old text 119 and 112. L2.I10 full run: 17 crates, 14338 gold spent, Titan and Kraken windows cost 2 hp, won Nightmare 1 (24:47).

claim: Even the narrow evade exception (boss within 200 or health under 40%) starves chests on some seeds, because bosses stay within 200 units for minutes; it survived 3 of 3 but gave 0 chests and no evolution on 2 of 3.
evidence: L3.I1: seed 1212 11 chests, evolution 1:29, 32 damage; seed 1313 0 chests, evade 19, 73 damage; seed 1414 0 chests, evade 20, 246 damage, ended 33/120 (Masher 101).

claim: A catalyst-committed pick prompt did not help on seed 1212: it took more damage and gave no evolution compared with the narrow text alone.
evidence: L3.I1.G4: 161 damage, 24 evades, 1 chest, no evolution, hp 69/120 vs G1 32 damage, 11 chests, pressure-cooker 1:29. Fewer chests came from the goal behaviour, so the pick effect is confounded.

claim: Plain chest-first survived 7 of 10 fresh seeds comfortably (1313, 1414, 1515, 1616, 1717, 1818, 2222); seeds 1919 and 2020 died at 4:52 and 4:45 and seed 2121 ended at 33/120, all three with 0 chests and no evolution.
evidence: L3.I5.G1 seed 2020 died 4:45 (first chest listed 3:25, elite goals 1 done/11 dropped, 11 dashes). G2 seed 2121 alive 33/120, 0 chests, 15 evades, 16 dashes. G3 seed 2222 62 damage, 9 chests, big-fry 1:47. Gym e repeat 27 damage, 9 chests.

claim: Gym nm1-min5-fresh-d (weak level-15 build, no evolution) kills the bot within about a minute under every goal text, so it cannot separate variants and is retired.
evidence: L3.I2.G5 died 61s, L3.I3.G4 died 75s (the-masher, late-blight).

claim: An armor and dodge first pick prompt alone does not lower late damage on a natural build that already holds bought items.
evidence: L2.I8.G4 (armor picks only) took 314 damage, with no armor or dodge cards logged, against baselines 231 and 308 and the gold-rule games 22 and 77. One game; the effect cannot be separated from the gold rule in G5.

claim: Even the tight evade exception (boss within 100 or health under 30%) costs chests and evolutions compared with plain chest-first on the same seed.
evidence: L3.I3 seed 1616: tight gave 1 chest, 13 evades, 8 dashes, no evolution, 214 damage, ended 77/120; plain gave 7 chests, tater-minigun 2:41, 115 damage, 120/120. On seed 1414 (L3.I2) tight gave 7 chests, so seed-dependent. One game each on 1616.

claim: The gold/shop rule did not hurt on the 15:00 map-c gym (alive 20:00, 246 damage vs plain 107), spending 9574 gold with 11 shrines and 6 items; damage benefit unproven.
evidence: L3.I4.G4 plain 107 damage, 0 spent; G5 gold rule 246 damage, 9574 spent, kraken 214 vs 107.

claim: Plain chest-first lived about 13 of 17 fresh NM1 seeds and 5 of 5 NM2 seeds under lockstep; these rates do not carry to live NM2.
evidence: Live NM2 rehearsal 1 of 5 and the L3.I10 full run died 2:15.

claim: Neither planEvery 10 nor exploreDistance 600 is safe to ship: planEvery 10 killed good seeds 1313 and 1818, and explore 600 killed good seed 1313 and left seed 2020 dead twice.
evidence: L3.I7: planEvery 10 s1313 died 4:59 (0 chests), s1818 died 4:01 (0 chests). L3.I8: explore 600 s1313 died 4:07 (2 chests, no evolution), s2020 died 4:08 (0 chests); s1818, s1616, s2222 fine (9-10 chests). L3.I6: explore 600 rescued 1919 and 2121. Plain: 1313 alive with 7 chests.

claim: Steam-vent, lockstep 1 and the chest-first goal text with the 10:00 gold rule win Nightmare 1: the full run passed 20:00 and lived to 24:47.
evidence: L2.I10 full run seed TIBO10: 24:47, level 73, 545 damage in 24 minutes, 63 boss chests, 18 bosses killed, 17 crates bought, hp 150/150 from 15:00 to 20:00; lost 2 hp at 17:00 and 0 at 18:00-19:00 through the Titan and Kraken. Earlier runs with the same base but no gold rule died at 17:20 and 18:36. One full run; the rehearsal had 4 of 5 fresh seeds alive at 5:00.

claim: The default pick behaviour wastes level-ups and a weapon slot on on-dash weapons (Mash Landing) because the bot dashes about twice a run.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: Mash Landing took picks at 1:56, 7:27, 9:27, 10:20, 10:22 and the 10:36 whetstone, ending 8/8 and never evolving (needs Mash Splat); dashes used 2 (21:07, 21:11). No test against an alternative yet.

claim: A 120-150 max hp build takes 100-119 hp from a single boss burst (Deep Freezer, Fryer King, Pack Lord), which is 70-80% of max hp, and survives only because Pressure Cooker, Root Network regen and Pickle Jar heal it back. Nightmare 2 will make bursts larger.
evidence: L2.I10 full run: 14:00 lost 103 gained 102 (Deep Freezer, 150/150); 21:00 lost 113 gained 120 (Fryer King); 24:46 lost 116 in one step (150 to 34) to Pack Lord and died. Max hp was 120 until 11:00 and 150 after; no hp passive taken.

claim: Time lived after 20:00 does not count for the ladder, so deaths after 20:00 are not failures; the next goal is the next Nightmare level.
evidence: Game facts: winning means surviving to 20:00; the ladder moved to Nightmare 2 after the 24:47 full run.

claim: From a natural 10:00 build the bot with the gold rule spent most of its gold: 17 crates, shrines and a whetstone by 24:39, 14338 of 17767 gold, versus 838 of 7946 without the rule.
evidence: L2.I10 full run spot goals 28 done, 1 gave up, 3 dropped; gold spent 14338; items bought stat 0 but crates bought 17. L1.I10 full run: gold earned 7946, spent 838, crates 6.

claim: All NM2 gym results and fresh-seed 5:00 survival in L3.I1-I9 were measured under lockstep and are leads only; live play loses most fresh NM2 seeds in the first 4 minutes.
evidence: Live L3.I10 rehearsal 1 of 5 alive at 300s and full run died 2:15, against 5 of 5 under lockstep. Late gyms (15:00-20:00) were all lockstep and have not been retested live.

claim: A Gravy Heart-after-catalysts pick prompt raised max hp on the NM2 10:00 gym (155 vs 120) but did not change survival, and damage was not lower (37 vs 22). No benefit is shown on the 10:00-15:00 stretch, which is too easy to separate variants.
evidence: L3.I1.G5 Gravy Heart picks 155/155 hp, 37 damage vs baseline 120/120 hp, 22 damage, from the 10:00 gym, where the 6 passive slots were already full, so the pick prompt could only affect a few levels. A fair test has to start from 0:00 on fresh seeds (nm2-hp-picks-early, L3.I7).

claim: Plain chest-first without the 10:00 gold rule lives about 17:20-18:36 on NM1: it left gold unspent, max hp at 120-132 and died to the 16:00+ crowd.
evidence: L3.I10 full run 17:33: gold earned 9997, spent 580, 1 crate, 0 shrines, max hp 132, 0 dashes, died to grease-fiend/ice-imp at 17:25-17:33. Earlier 17:20 and 18:36 runs same base; 24:47 with gold rule.

claim: Live on NM2 the early deaths come from pests (sand-crab, potato-beetle, snow-mold, fry-fly) plus the 2:00 Festival Mascot, hitting builds at level 5-11 with steam-vent at 1-4 and no evolution; the Mascot can deal about 50 in a single hit and 120+ in a few seconds.

claim: Default picks take the catalyst (Root Network x3) before the starting weapon is levelled and then spread levels over Chip Shuriken, Butter Streak (on-dash) and Peeler, so Steam Vent stays at 1-4 of 8 and no evolution comes by 2:15.

claim: Fighting elites with a 1/8 weapon among 80-90 enemies between 1:30 and 2:00 costs about 60 hp and leaves the bot at under half hp when the Mascot arrives at 2:00.

claim: Starch Plating 2 from 0:00 does not carry live NM2 seeds to 5:00 on its own: both seeds lived 1-1.5 minutes longer than their controls but died at 3:58 and 4:04 to the 3:00-4:00 bosses with no evolution.

evidence: L4.I3.G1 seed 1919 died 2:19 (Steam Vent 4/8, 0 chests, 0 elites killed, 9 dashes) vs control 2:30; G2 seed 4141 died 2:12 (amusing 111, Steam Vent 3/8, 0 chests) vs control 3:06. Steam Vent dealt only about 4000 damage in 140 s. Two games, so a lead.

claim: Starting with Hot Streak 1 + Thick Skin 1 lives 5:00 on both live NM2 seeds that kill the unchanged playbook (1919, 4141): Wildfire Roast at 1:09 and 1:41, 18 boss chests each, 0 dashes, 61 and 71 damage. It is an upper bound, because Hot Streak is not a startable weapon.
evidence: L4.I3.G3 seed 1919 alive 109/120, 61 damage, 2961 kills; G4 seed 4141 alive 164/164, 71 damage, 4260 kills. Controls on the same seeds died at 2:30 and 3:06. Combined with L4.I2 survivors that also held Hot Streak (B98).

claim: A goal text that ranks free spots (shrine, whetstone, dog) after chests and elites does not help the live NM2 opening: it used 1 shrine and died at 2:40 with 10 evades and 0 chests.
evidence: L4.I3.G5 seed 1919: died 2:40, damage 238 (sand-crab 52.8, amusing 48.7), 14 dashes, fry-lance 5, no evolution; control died 2:30. One game.

claim: Early survival on live NM2 follows early weapon damage: Steam Vent games deal about 4000 damage by 2:15 and kill 0 elites, so they get no chests. Fry-lance and Hot Streak games dealt several times more and got elites and chests. Chests are not placed on the map, so exploring cannot find them; only elites, bosses and nests drop them.
evidence: L4.I3.G1/G2 Steam Vent 3932 and 3738 damage dealt, 0 elites, 0 chests, dead 2:12-2:19; G5 fry-lance 11535 dealt in 160 s with 6 elites killed but 0 chests and death; G3/G4 Hot Streak line 18 chests, alive. Explore goals ended 'found nothing' 14 times in the L3.I10 full run.

evidence: L4.I4.G2 peeler s4141: alive 149/149, Mandoline Fury 1:30, 18 chests, 222 damage. G1 peeler s1919 died 2:03 (Mascot 62.6, garden-slug 49, 3 chests, no evolution). claim: On live NM2 seed 1919 every dead game lost 66-89 hp in minute 1, whichever weapon it held, and reached the 2:00 Mascot at 4-13 hp. Minute-1 pest chip damage (garden-slug, sand-crab, potato-beetle, snow-mold) is the main early killer, and the Mascot is the finisher.
evidence: L4.I4 minute-1 losses on 1919/4141: peeler 66, root-spikes 89 and 68, explore-600 83 (sand-crab 54). Earlier: L4.I1 1919 lost 117 in 1:00-2:00. The peeler survivor on 4141 lost 53 but gained 35.

claim: A Hot Streak pick prompt (take Hot Streak when offered, then Thick Skin, at most 3 weapons, no on-dash weapons) does not steer a Steam Vent start into Wildfire Roast and does not lift live NM2 survival: it lived 1 of 4 seeds.
evidence: L4.I5 live: s1919 died 2:10 (Steam Vent 5/8, 0 chests, snow-mold 95.6), s4141 died 2:09 (sand-crab 100, 0 chests), s4242 died 3:16 (0 chests, cave-grub 85), s2020 alive 83 damage but with Pressure Cooker and Hot Streak 4, never Wildfire Roast. claim: The action.hurt prompt that names slow tanks, chargers and ground hazards does not raise live NM2 survival: on the four paired seeds it lived 1 of 4, exactly like the unchanged controls. Its early 4 of 5 was noise.
evidence: L4.I7 hurt prompt on 2121, 1313, 4343, 4444: only 4343 alive. L4.I8 unchanged controls on the same seeds: only 4343 alive (98/120), 2121 died 2:27, 1313 died 2:03, 4444 died 2:15. Pooled hurt prompt 5 of 10 (L4.I5-I7) against unchanged live about 4 of 14.

claim: A hurt prompt that names only ground hazards does not help live NM2 seed 1919. It died at 2:01 with no better minute-1 loss than the controls, so the benefit of the full prompt, if real, is not from the hazard clause.
evidence: L4.I6.G5 s1919: died 2:01, lost 108 hp in minute 1 (potato-beetle 54.9, wireworm-larva 18.7, sand-crab 19), 13 dashes, 1 chest, no evolution, against the full prompt alive on 1919 twice. One game.

claim: Live NM2 runs that reach 2:00 below about 35 hp are finished by the Festival Mascot. In three of the four L4.I7 hurt-prompt deaths amusing was the killing blow at 2:08-2:24, with hp 3-34 at 2:00. Minute 0-1 chip damage sets the hp the Mascot meets.
evidence: L4.I7.G1 s2121: lost 100 hp in minute 0 (tomato-leech 66, hot oil 31), 23 dashes, 5/134 at 2:00, died 2:14. G4 s4444: 3/120 at 2:00, died 2:24. G5 s4545: 34/120 at 2:00, died 2:08. G3 s4343 reached 2:00 at 116/120 and lived. B95 and B105 show the same minute-1 loss on 1919 and 4141.

claim: extraDamage 0 does not raise live NM2 survival. The 1919 survivor was luck on a high-variance seed.
evidence: L4.I9: extraDamage 0 lived 1 of 5 (2121 alive 104/120; 1313, 4444, 4141 and 4343 died at 2:09, 2:19, 2:03 and 2:09, no evolution, 0-4 chests). With 1919 that is 2 of 6, against controls on the same seeds of about 1 of 6. The rule said refuted at 2 or fewer of 5. On 4343, where the control lived, extraDamage 0 died with amusing 63.7.

claim: The unchanged playbook lives 5:00 on only about 5 of 28 live fresh NM2 starts. Deaths cluster at 2:02-3:22 with no evolution and 0-3 chests; the 2:00 Mascot or the 3:00 Colorado Queen finishes the bot, sometimes after minute-1 chip damage and sometimes at full hp (L8.I10 full run, 109/120 at 2:00).
evidence: Earlier 5 of 20, plus L8.I8.G5 seed 5252 died 3:12, the L8.I10 rehearsal 0 of 5 and the L8.I10 full run died 2:14 at 109/120 hp entering 2:00.

claim: The NM1 15:00 and 10:00 plain gyms cannot show a gold-rule or hp-pick effect. Plain play takes 0-250 damage, and the gold rule or hp picks sometimes raised damage or killed the run, but never lowered damage reliably.
evidence: L4.I1-L4.I6: plain-f 15:00 plain 0-5 damage; gold rule 183 and 163 damage; gold+hp picks died 18:51 (710). claim: Plain chest-first lived the two extra fresh NM1 seeds tested under lockstep (3535 at 66/120 hp, 3636 at 192/192). That says nothing about live NM2.
evidence: L4.I9.G4 seed 3535: 282 damage, 3 chests, no evolution, ended 66/120. L4.I9.G5 seed 3636: 69 damage, 12 chests, pressure-cooker 1:56. Both lockstep on NM1; fresh NM1 plain now lives about 15 of 19.

claim: The low-hp clause of the chest-first goal text (health low: rate food and evading highest) makes the bot walk away from chests it just paid for, so an elite kill that drops chests at low hp yields no power.
evidence: L4.I10 full run: after the 1:03-1:19 slug fight hp was 43/120 (36%). Planner rated Keep away 76-79% and Open the chest 19% with chests 56, 95, 96 and 112 units away. Five 8 s evade goals followed, the nearest chest was 477 units away by 1:40 and the list was empty by 1:48. 0 chests opened by death at 2:25.

claim: With hp above 50% the goal text rates Keep away from enemies under 30%, even with 100+ enemies near and the Mascot 43-226 units away, so the bot explores, charges nests and fights spores into the Mascot.
evidence: L4.I10 full run 2:00-2:25 at hp 76 down to 30: Keep away rated 22, 24, 27, 18% while Explore 54-62%, Beetle Nest 55%, Fight the Blight Spore 55%. Mascot 43 units away at 2:20; hp -19 in one step at 2:23.

claim: On NM2 explore finds nothing useful in the first 2 minutes: chests only come from elites, nests and bosses (B103), so 300-unit explore legs spend the cheapest minute walking into pests.
evidence: L4.I10 full run: 13 explores done and 3 dropped, 0 chests found by exploring, all 5 listed chests came from the one elite kill at 1:19. The Beetle Nest (an elite nest) was listed from 1:41 at 238-309 units and rated 23-39% until 2:18.

claim: In a crowd of 35+ enemies at hp below about 80, the action model rates almost every move as costing more than the safest one, so it cannot pick a good step; hp has to be protected before the crowd forms.
evidence: L4.I10 full run 1:05-1:19: most of 8 moves per row 'ruled out' (-5 to -22 hp forecasts) while hp fell 99 to 43; same at 2:20-2:25 where all 9 moves were rated dead.

claim: Default picks favour the newest base weapons (Harvest Moon 84%, Comet Scythe 79%, Hash Hawk 61%) over levelling what is held; six weapons at 1/8 deal about 87 dps in total but give no evolution by 2:25.
evidence: L4.I10 full run: 12.6k damage in 145 s across six weapons (Hash Hawk 3408, Seed Potato 2473, Comet Scythe 2444, Harvest Moon 2443, Steam Vent 1269, Fry Knives 559), no weapon past 2/8, Skip rated 3-7%.

claim: The unchanged live playbook died on every one of the seeds chosen for the chest-before-evade test (1919, 4141, 2121, 1313, 4444), so those seeds give a fair paired baseline of 0 of 5 alive at 5:00.
